## Standing operator rules
Always run `make license-check` from the repository root after changing `requirements/base.txt`.

Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.

“Migrate Test Workflow to GitHub Actions” must run separately between other work, one step at a time, in the specified order.

Always paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

Staging Redis is `cache-eu-3`; `cache-eu-1` must not receive writes.

## Current objective
Fix scheduler recurrence across DST transitions. Earlier JPY rounding and PDF export work is paused; GitHub Actions migration is paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Branch: `gha/test-workflow`; Redis: `cache-eu-3`; invoice: `1048`; request context: `current_request_id`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Pinning `httpx` to 0.23 broke the Stripe client.

## Plan and progress
Done: preserve local recurrence wall time using timezone-aware `datetime.combine`; add spring-DST 00:30 regression test. Scheduler tests: 8 passed. Pending full regression; next: `pytest -q`.

## Recent work
Added safe settings-source debug metadata, request-ID null-format coverage, and corrected health-log expectations. Reproduced and fixed the March DST shift. Verified timezone offsets. Last full-suite result predates the scheduler fix: 142 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed.
